content: Caddy On-Demand TLS obtains certs during the TLS handshake for previously-unknown hostnames rather than at config load, ideal for multi-tenant SaaS where customers add their own domains dynamically. Must gate it with an 'ask' endpoint (internal HTTP endpoint Caddy calls to confirm a hostname is allowed) to prevent abuse/rate-limit exhaustion. Let's Encrypt limits: 300 new orders/account/3h, 50 certs/registered-domain/week — fine for per-domain certs at moderate scale; wildcard certs need DNS-01 challenge instead and don't fit arbitrary customer domains anyway (customers bring apex/subdomains you don't control DNS for).
